planSteps.description: If there is a 'Click to Continue' button on a warning page, click it to proceed to the application
Type 'sarah.jenkins@vanntagge.com' into the input field with id 'login-email'
Type 'TEST' into the CAPTCHA text input field
Click the submit button to sign in
The page displays the welcome header 'Your Operations Workspace'
Click on the Workloads navigation link in the sidebar
